title: The Lookout Café
cuisine: Contemporary café dishes, local flavours & cocktails
summary: Breakfast, lunch, sunset drinks or dinner above Batoka Gorge, with views towards Victoria Falls Bridge.
body: The Lookout Café sits above the Batoka Gorge, with tables looking towards the river and Victoria Falls Bridge. Breakfast and lunch suit a visit around the rainforest or high-wire activities; later bookings catch the changing light over the gorge.

The operator describes contemporary café cooking alongside local dishes, with cocktails, wine and beer. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options are listed, but discuss allergies directly with the kitchen. Full-moon dinners are separate dated events, rather than the regular dinner service.

planning.label: Book the service
planning.text: Specify breakfast, lunch, dinner or a full-moon event and request your preferred seating.

planning.label: Kitchen hours
planning.text: Check last food orders as well as the restaurant closing time.

planning.label: Activities
planning.text: Leave time for briefings and transfers; a restaurant table does not include a high-wire activity.

sources.title: The Lookout Café · Official venue information

alt: The Lookout Café · official venue photograph
highlights: Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options are listed

title: Baines Restaurant
summary: A riverside restaurant and deck for a longer meal, a special occasion or drinks beside the upper Zambezi.
body: Baines Restaurant occupies a riverbank setting upstream of the Falls on Zambezi Drive. The deck opens towards the water, making the setting especially relevant when choosing a longer lunch, drinks or a special-occasion meal.

Check the current menu before choosing a fixed dining time, and request a riverside table rather than assuming one is reserved. For an outdoor booking, ask what happens in rain or strong sun and arrange the return journey to your accommodation.

planning.label: Your table
planning.text: Request the outlook and seating you prefer and check the outdoor weather arrangements.

planning.label: Menu
planning.text: Confirm the current service, dietary requirements and any group menu.

planning.label: Transfers
planning.text: Arrange pickup and return transport, especially for an evening reservation.

title: Stanley’s Terrace
atmosphere: A hotel terrace with bridge views
summary: Traditional afternoon tea and light meals on the heritage hotel terrace, overlooking the bridge and Falls spray.
body: Stanley’s Terrace is the outdoor terrace at The Victoria Falls Hotel, looking across the lawns towards the bridge and waterfall spray. Afternoon tea is its signature visit, while a separate all-day menu offers lighter meals.

The hotel publishes a dedicated afternoon-tea serving window and asks non-residents to pre-book with its food and beverage team. State that you are booking tea rather than a regular meal, and discuss dietary adaptations and access through the hotel in advance.

planning.label: Non-resident visits
planning.text: Pre-book with the hotel before travelling to the terrace.

planning.label: Tea service
planning.text: Confirm the current serving window, menu and number of guests covered by your booking.

planning.label: Seating
planning.text: Request shade or a preferred outlook and discuss access and dietary needs.

sources.title: The Victoria Falls Hotel · Stanley’s Terrace

alt: Outdoor tables and umbrellas on Stanley’s Terrace at The Victoria Falls Hotel
highlights: Light meals on a heritage hotel terrace

title: MaKuwa-Kuwa Restaurant
atmosphere: Lodge dining with a waterhole setting
summary: Lodge dining above the bush and waterhole, with a different outlook from a town-centre restaurant.
body: MaKuwa-Kuwa is the main restaurant at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge. Its elevated lodge setting and views over the bush and waterhole make the outlook part of the meal, with wildlife sightings dependent on the day.

Ask which meal services are open to non-residents on your date. If combining a meal with Vulture Culture or another estate visit, confirm each arrangement and leave time between them. Restaurant reservations and estate experiences are separate unless your package says otherwise.

planning.label: Non-resident dining
planning.text: Confirm table availability and the service you want before visiting.

planning.label: Outlook
planning.text: Request a waterhole-facing table if that view is important to you.

planning.label: Estate visits
planning.text: Check activity times and transport independently of the restaurant reservation.

highlights: Restaurant at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge
A separate booking from estate activities

title: The Three Monkeys
summary: A central restaurant and bar for lunch, dinner or drinks, close to the town’s activity and shopping hubs.
body: The Three Monkeys is a restaurant and bar at the corner of Livingstone Way and Adam Stander Drive. Its central position makes it useful for lunch between outings or dinner after time in town.

The venue publishes a late-morning opening through to late evening. Check the current menu and kitchen cut-off rather than treating bar hours as food-service hours. For a larger party or a meal before a show, reserve and tell the team your timing.

planning.label: Reservations
planning.text: Book ahead for a larger group or a fixed pre-show dinner.

planning.label: Kitchen
planning.text: Check the current menu, dietary options and last orders.

planning.label: Location
planning.text: Use the Victoria Falls branch and arrange your return transport after dinner.

alt: The Three Monkeys · official venue photograph
highlights: Corner of Livingstone Way and Adam Stander Drive

title: Cassia Restaurant
cuisine: Hotel restaurant dishes & South African wines
summary: Garden and terrace dining at Ilala Lodge, from breakfast and poolside lunch to a more leisurely dinner.
body: Cassia Restaurant sits within Ilala Lodge’s gardens, with indoor dining and tables outdoors beneath the cassia trees. Breakfast combines a continental buffet with cooked choices; lunch includes lighter dishes and more substantial plates.

Evening dining is supported by a wine list focused on South African vineyards, alongside beer, gin and cocktails. The hotel also promotes a separate Zambezi River Deck dinner experience: confirm which venue you are reserving rather than assuming a Cassia booking is riverside.

planning.label: Meal and venue
planning.text: Specify Cassia and the meal service, or enquire separately about the river-deck experience.

planning.label: Non-residents
planning.text: Check table availability and access if you are not staying at Ilala Lodge.

planning.label: Seating
planning.text: Request indoor or terrace seating and share allergies when reserving.

highlights: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are published services
Wine list focused on South African vineyards

title: GOAT at Mama Africa
cuisine: Oxtail, pap, hunter’s pots & Western favourites
summary: African and Western dishes with a Zambezi river-history theme and a live township-jazz programme.
body: GOAT at Mama Africa combines African dishes such as oxtail and pap and hunter’s pots with Western favourites including steaks and nachos. Its walls tell stories of the rafting and kayaking pioneers of the Zambezi.

The venue publishes live township jazz on selected evenings. Ask what is scheduled for your date and whether you want a table near the performance or somewhere quieter. Food, music and group seating should be confirmed together when planning a fixed evening.

planning.label: Music
planning.text: Check the current performance nights and start time before booking.

planning.label: Food
planning.text: Ask which local dishes are available and discuss dietary requirements.

planning.label: Groups
planning.text: Confirm seating, any set menu and return transport.

alt: GOAT at Mama Africa · official venue photograph
highlights: Rafting and kayaking stories in the décor

title: River Brewing Co & The Smokehouse
atmosphere: Beer, grilled food & a sociable evening
summary: Craft beer on tap, fire-grilled food and a changing programme of live bands and DJs at one shared venue.
body: River Brewing Co and The Smokehouse bring beer and food together at 270 Adam Stander Drive. The published menu description includes flame-grilled dishes, burgers and crocodile souvlaki, with River beers on tap.

The setting changes from daytime meals to evenings with bands, DJs or other events. Check the actual programme and food-service times for your chosen date. They are associated offerings at one venue, so there is no need to plan them as two separate restaurant stops.

planning.label: Programme
planning.text: Confirm live music, DJ sets and any event arrangements for the date.

planning.label: Dining
planning.text: Check kitchen hours and reserve for a larger party.

planning.label: Beer
planning.text: Ask which beers are on tap; enquire separately about any brewery tour.

sources.title: River Brewing Co & The Smokehouse · Official venue information

alt: River Brewing Co & The Smokehouse · official venue photograph
highlights: River Brewing Co beers with Smokehouse food
Live bands and DJ events on selected dates

title: Zulu Bistro Bar
cuisine: Zimbabwean tasting menus & à la carte
summary: Explore Zimbabwean cooking through shared tasting dishes, an à la carte meal or a group set menu.
highlights: À la carte and group set-menu alternatives
body: Zulu Bistro Bar focuses on Zimbabwean everyday food and local ingredients. Its published options include a multi-dish tasting menu, combining sharing-style and individually plated courses, alongside à la carte choices.

The tasting menu is a longer food experience than a quick restaurant stop. Ask about the current dishes, portion arrangements and time needed. Groups can enquire about set menus or packed lunches, while dietary restrictions should be discussed before confirming a shared menu.

planning.label: Menu format
planning.text: Choose the tasting menu, à la carte or a group set menu when booking.

planning.label: Dietary needs
planning.text: Discuss allergies and substitutions before reserving shared dishes.

planning.label: Timing
planning.text: Allow time for multiple courses and confirm the current programme.

sources.title: Zulu Bistro Bar · Official venue information

title: Dusty Road Township Experience
cuisine: Zimbabwean food cooked over open fires
summary: A booked lunch or dinner in Chinotimba, with Zimbabwean cooking, open fires and inventive local décor.
body: Dusty Road is a restaurant in Chinotimba, with Zimbabwean food cooked over open fires and in cast-iron pots and ovens. Reused materials and colourful local details shape its courtyard and home-like dining spaces.

The venue publishes separate lunch and dinner services and says bookings are essential. Treat it as a planned meal, allowing time to enjoy the setting rather than squeezing it into a short transfer gap. Arrange transport to and from the restaurant through your accommodation or guide.

planning.label: Book first
planning.text: Reserve the meal service and confirm the current menu and total price.

planning.label: Dietary needs
planning.text: Tell the kitchen about allergies or restrictions before arrival.

planning.label: Transport
planning.text: Arrange the journey into Chinotimba and your return collection.

sources.title: Dusty Road Township Experience · Official venue information

alt: A colourful fire-cooked dish prepared at Dusty Road

title: Victoria Falls Distilling Company
cuisine: Locally distilled gin, cocktails & sharing boards
summary: Zimbabwean botanical gin, cocktails and charcuterie or cheese boards in a central distillery bar.
body: Victoria Falls Distilling Company presents its gin through Zimbabwean botanicals and a bar serving cocktails, charcuterie and cheese boards. It offers a drinks-led stop rather than a full restaurant meal.

The official address is at Livingstone Way and Adam Stander Drive, with entry via The Three Monkeys. Ask about tasting formats, reservations and the current food offering. A drink at the bar does not automatically include a guided distillery tour.

planning.label: Tastings
planning.text: Confirm the format, availability and charges for any guided tasting or tour.

planning.label: Food
planning.text: Check sharing-board availability and dietary requirements.

planning.label: Getting back
planning.text: Arrange return transport if drinking and confirm the entrance before travelling.

sources.title: Victoria Falls Distilling Company · Official venue information

alt: Guests at the bar and tables inside Victoria Falls Distilling Company

title: The Rainforest Café
atmosphere: A shaded break around a Falls visit
summary: A café stop around the rainforest visit, with breakfast, light meals, cold drinks and coffee.
highlights: A café in the rainforest visitor area
body: The Rainforest Café is associated with the Victoria Falls rainforest visitor area, offering a place to pause around a walk through the viewpoints. Published menu descriptions include breakfasts, wraps, salads, toasted sandwiches, burgers and fish.

Plan it around your park visit and ask about the current access arrangements. The café’s closing time, kitchen hours and park admission are separate considerations, so do not assume a table booking provides entry to the rainforest.

planning.label: Access
planning.text: Confirm the meeting point and whether park admission is needed for your intended visit.

planning.label: Timing
planning.text: Check food-service hours against your Falls tour or transfer.

planning.label: Menu
planning.text: Ask about current dishes, children’s portions and dietary options.

sources.title: The Rainforest Café · Official venue information

alt: Fresh sandwiches displayed at The Rainforest Café

title: The Bridge Café
summary: A meal or drink overlooking the bridge and gorge, close to the bridge activity platforms.
highlights: Outlook towards the bridge and gorge
A café stop near bridge activities
Access arrangements to confirm before travelling
body: The Bridge Café occupies a viewpoint near Victoria Falls Bridge and the Batoka Gorge. It suits a pause around a bridge tour or time watching the activity platforms, with café food and drinks.

Bridge-area access is different from visiting a restaurant in town. Ask about passport requirements and the current border-area formalities for your route. A café visit, a bridge tour and a jump or slide remain separate bookings.

planning.label: Access
planning.text: Confirm passport and bridge-area access requirements before leaving your accommodation.

planning.label: Activities
planning.text: Allow separate time for activity check-in and safety briefings.

planning.label: Food service
planning.text: Check the current menu and kitchen hours for your planned visit.

sources.title: The Bridge Café · Official venue information

alt: A meal and cold drink with the bridge beyond at The Bridge Café

title: Marula Café
cuisine: Café breakfasts, fish, grills & casual dishes
summary: A town-centre option for morning coffee, lunch or dinner, with local fish and casual restaurant dishes.
highlights: Breakfast, lunch and evening menu options
Published dishes include Zambezi bream and grills
body: Marula Café serves the town centre with a menu that changes through the day: coffee and breakfast dishes, then salads, sandwiches, pasta, burgers and more substantial restaurant choices.

Shearwater’s dining information highlights local ingredients including Zambezi bream and Zimbabwean beef. Check the menu for your meal time and any evening entertainment. For a group heading to a show, confirm service time and tell the team when you need to leave.

planning.label: Meal time
planning.text: Check which menu is served when you plan to arrive.

planning.label: Groups
planning.text: Reserve larger tables and mention any fixed theatre or activity time.

planning.label: Dietary needs
planning.text: Confirm current vegetarian choices and allergy arrangements.

alt: Marula Café staff presenting prepared meals

title: Victoria Falls Coffee Company
cuisine: Locally roasted coffee & beans to take home
summary: A shaded café and local roastery for a cup of Zimbabwean coffee or beans to take home.
highlights: Café on Metcalfe Road beside GOAT
Coffee roasted locally in small batches
Whole beans and ground coffee to take home
body: Victoria Falls Coffee Company’s café sits beneath mango trees on Metcalfe Road, beside GOAT. The roastery works with Zimbabwean coffee from the Eastern Highlands alongside other origins and blends.

Ask what is being served on the day or choose beans ground for your brewing method. The published range includes single-origin Zimbabwe coffee and changing blends. Check café hours directly; this guide describes a coffee stop rather than promising a full breakfast or restaurant menu.

planning.label: Visit
planning.text: Confirm current café hours and the exact entrance on Metcalfe Road.

planning.label: Coffee
planning.text: Ask which beans and brewing options are available that day.

planning.label: Take home
planning.text: Request whole beans or the grind suitable for your own equipment.

sources.title: Victoria Falls Coffee Company · Official venue information

alt: The shaded café building at Victoria Falls Coffee Company

title: Shoestrings Bar
summary: An informal bar at Shoestrings, with live acts, DJs and a changing calendar of evening events.
body: Shoestrings Bar is part of the backpackers’ property on West Drive, with a sociable setting, live acts and DJ events. It is an option for an informal evening rather than a quiet dining-room reservation.

The venue publishes event-specific entry arrangements, including selected sessions with a redeemable entry charge. Check the current programme, entry conditions and food availability for your date. Pool and other property facilities should be confirmed separately for non-resident visitors.

planning.label: Events
planning.text: Confirm the date’s line-up, entry conditions and any advance booking.

planning.label: Food
planning.text: Check whether food is being served during your chosen event.

planning.label: Return journey
planning.text: Arrange collection back to your accommodation before the evening.

alt: The poolside social area and bar buildings at Shoestrings

title: The Livingstone Room
cuisine: À la carte & table d’hôte dinner
summary: A more formal dinner in the heritage hotel’s Edwardian dining room, with a dress code to check before visiting.
highlights: À la carte and table d’hôte menus
body: The Livingstone Room is the formal dining room at The Victoria Falls Hotel, with an Edwardian interior and dinner service. It offers a different evening from the hotel’s outdoor terrace or Jungle Junction buffet.

The hotel publishes dress requirements, restricted operating days and a child policy. Confirm all three when reserving, especially if coming straight from a safari outing. Ask whether the current service is à la carte or table d’hôte and allow time for a more leisurely dinner.

planning.label: Dress
planning.text: Check the current dress code; the hotel excludes safari wear, shorts and some casual footwear.

planning.label: Guest policy
planning.text: Confirm child restrictions and the dining room’s operating days.

planning.label: Reservations
planning.text: Non-residents should pre-book and specify the Livingstone Room.

sources.title: The Livingstone Room · Official venue information

alt: The formal dining room and arches at The Livingstone Room

title: Jungle Junction
summary: Breakfast or a buffet dinner in the hotel’s open-air dining setting, with entertainment arrangements to confirm.
body: Jungle Junction is the outdoor-style restaurant at The Victoria Falls Hotel. Its published breakfast and dinner services centre on buffets, with the gardens, gorge and Falls spray forming the outlook.

The hotel describes evening entertainment, while group and private-event arrangements have their own conditions. Ask what is scheduled for your date rather than assuming every dinner includes the same programme. Non-resident meals and larger groups should be reserved in advance.

planning.label: Service
planning.text: Confirm breakfast or dinner availability and the current buffet arrangement.

planning.label: Programme
planning.text: Ask what entertainment is scheduled and whether any element is separately charged.

planning.label: Groups
planning.text: Check the hotel’s group conditions, seating and non-resident booking requirements.

alt: Outdoor dining at sunrise beside the gardens at Jungle Junction
